Agent incorrectly identified the coin as depicting Pompey the Great. The ground truth is Marcus Aurelius Probus (Roman Emperor, 276-282 CE). These are entirely different historical figures from different eras - Pompey lived 106-48 BCE during the Republic, while Probus was a 3rd century CE Emperor. The agent's search strategy focused on 'PROPUS' which should have led to 'PROBUS' but instead converged on Pompey/POMPEIUS. Fundamental factual error.
